description: This is a shell script designed to automate the restart process of the OpenClaw application on macOS. It performs tasks such as killing existing instances, rebuilding the application, signing, packaging, and launching the app, as well as installing related launch agents and verifying the app's operation.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message and exits the script

methods.name: run_step
methods.description: Executes a command with a label, logs the step, and handles failure

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Removes lock directory if exists during script cleanup

methods.name: acquire_lock
methods.description: Attempts to create a lock directory to prevent concurrent script runs

methods.name: check_signing_keys
methods.description: Checks if valid code signing identities are available on the system

methods.name: choose_app_bundle
methods.description: Determines the application bundle path, either from environment or default locations

methods.name: kill_all_openclaw
methods.description: Kills all running OpenClaw processes and related instances

methods.name: stop_launch_agent
methods.description: Stops the launch agent for OpenClaw
